description: Generated DeviceID mapping row count matches the source transaction count.
TransactionID is unique in the DeviceID mapping.
Every transaction retains a CustomerID.
Every transaction records its DeviceID assignment method.
Every source TransactionID is represented exactly in the DeviceID mapping.
TransactionDT is preserved in the generated mapping.
Source DeviceType values are preserved without modification.
Source DeviceInfo values are preserved without modification.
Only documented DeviceID assignment methods are present.
Every transaction with both DeviceType and DeviceInfo receives a DeviceID.
No DeviceID is generated when either required source device field is missing.
Transactions with complete device evidence use CUSTOMER_NESTED_DEVICE_SIGNATURE.
Transactions with incomplete device evidence use INSUFFICIENT_DEVICE_EVIDENCE.
NULL DeviceID occurs only when source device evidence is insufficient.
Every NULL DeviceID records INSUFFICIENT_DEVICE_EVIDENCE.
Every generated DeviceID belongs to exactly one CustomerID.
The same CustomerID + DeviceType + DeviceInfo signature always maps to one DeviceID.
Each DeviceID corresponds to only one customer-device signature.
Every generated DeviceID matches the documented deterministic hash rule.
Generated DeviceID count matches the number of transactions with complete source device evidence.
NULL DeviceID count matches the number of transactions with incomplete device evidence.
